items.title: Steve Angrum Interview, 1961-08-08
items.q: You played with the Sheik? Punch Miller. Punch Miller. Yeah. How did you like that section? I liked that section very well.

ctx.x: Yeah. Two days ago. You played with the Sheik? Punch Miller. Punch Miller. Yeah. How did you like that section? I liked that section very well. It was a good section. You didn't get nervous? Well, I was nervous on the first. When I was starting off, I wasn't nervous. I was real nervous. I was wondering how I was going to sound. Yeah. Yeah. You know what I was like making them in front. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. You were like getting mad as it seems, isn't it? Sure was. But I was afraid though for a while. I was…
